feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: A student hated reading for years. Her podcast explores finding the right diagnosis
entry.summary: Middle schooler Cora Walsh of Long Island, N.Y., has won the 2026 NPR Student Podcast Challenge with a story about her journey with dyslexia.

entry.title: NEWSBRIEF: HURRICANE ISAIAS, UKRAINE WAR LATEST, POLITICS OF IRAN WAR
entry.summary: Gulf Coast Preps for Isaias, Ukraine expects Russian winter offensive, and Trump's Iran War in focus as Midterms approach.

entry.title: Gulf Coast residents get ready for Hurricane Isaias landfall
entry.summary: People along the Gulf Coast are awaiting the landfall of Hurricane Isaias.

entry.title: Pensacola mayor talks Hurricane Isaias preparations
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with D.C. Reeves, the mayor of Pensacola, Fla., as the coastal city prepares for Hurricane Isaias.

entry.title: Long-deployed USS Lincoln servicemembers reunited with families
entry.summary: On Thursday in San Diego, servicemembers who have been on an extended deployment on the USS Abraham Lincoln were reunited with family members.

entry.title: Aaron Sorkin warns of Facebook's recklessness in 'The Social Reckoning'
entry.summary: Sorkin's latest film follows Mark Zuckerberg as his company fights lawsuits and whistleblowers after modifying its algorithm to promote reshares, which overwhelmingly tend to be divisive.

entry.title: Advocates say ICE has secretly been using warehouses to detain people
entry.summary: In one New Jersey town immigration advocates say ICE has been secretly using one of its warehouses to detain people, which may be in violation of court orders prohibiting their use.

entry.title: RFK Jr. touts vaccine injury initiative, worrying experts
entry.summary: Heath Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announces new steps aimed at identifying and treating complications from vaccines.

entry.title: Navajo environmentalists were offered money to drop opposition to energy project
entry.summary: On the Navajo Reservation, a would-be energy developer appears to have tried to bribe a local environmental group to drop opposition to his project.

entry.title: After his university cutbacks, Trump announces $100 million for STEM researchers
entry.summary: The Trump administration is funneling $100 million into educating STEM researchers who are U.S. citizens. The move comes after other changes under Trump have forced cutbacks in university research.
